generator: Codex CLI（codex exec -m gpt-6-astra）呼叫其內建圖像工具 image_gen.imagegen；圖像工具的底層模型未公開

design.description: 深藍底、金色八芒星核與四段斷環契印；中央菱形留白，無文字。
design.background: #0b1230（提示詞及 maskable 外圍填色；生成原圖有輕微色差與紋理）
design.originality: 由文字提示生成原創星徽；未讀取或使用 assets/user/ 內圖像，不代表已進行全網商標相似性查核。

generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one production-ready original square mobile RPG app icon for a new original game named Starfall Covenant (星骸契約). Do NOT put any words or letters in the image.
Design: a strong, distinctive star covenant emblem: a large upright four-point falling-star core, with shorter diagonal facets suggesting an eight-point star, enclosed by two thick broken circular covenant arcs. A small clean dark diamond-shaped negative-space aperture at the very center. The downward star point is slightly longer, evoking a fallen celestial shard. Use bold solid silhouette, broad geometric facets, warm pale-gold face and restrained antique-gold bevels. Elegant, confident, highly legible and premium fantasy seal, not a busy illustration.
Palette inspired only by project CSS: full-bleed solid midnight navy #0b1230 background; star gold #f2c45a; soft gold highlights #fff0c1; bronze shaded facets #967240. Very restrained cyan glint may appear in the core; gold is dominant.
Composition: exact square, perfectly centered. Entire star AND every arc must fit INSIDE a circle of radius 35 percent of the image width, centered at 50%,50% (not merely inside a square). Outer 15 percent of each edge must be uninterrupted navy background. This must remain complete under Android maskable cropping to the central 80-percent-diameter safety circle. Background is opaque and fills the entire square, including all four corners. Do not pre-round the corners.
This will be shown at 60px and 32px: simplify aggressively, thick arcs and clear negative spaces, strong bright-on-dark contrast, avoid hairlines, ornate detail, small stars, particles, fine textures, glitter, lens flares, large bloom, scenes, characters, lettering, watermarks and mockups. One icon only, no grid. All shapes must be original; no existing game characters, art, logos, or identifiable franchise emblems. No reference images.

postprocessing: sips -z 512 512 SOURCE --out icon-512.png；直接縮放，不裁切、不加圓角。
Node.js 解碼 PNG 的 RGB scanline、還原 PNG filters，將原 448×448 像素不變地置於 512×512 畫布的 (32,32)。外圍 32px 填滿 #0b1230，輸出 8-bit RGB、無 Alpha、sRGB 的 PNG（zlib level=9）。

safe_zone.description: 中央 80% 直徑的圓形安全區；非僅檢查中央方形。

validation.detection: r > 75 and g > 55 and r > 1.3*b；配合目視檢查判斷徽記範圍。

postprocessing: sips -z 180 180 icon-512.png --out apple-touch-icon.png；保留不透明背景與完整方形邊角。

validation.scope: PNG 解碼、尺寸、透明度、maskable 星徽像素安全半徑、小尺寸目視檢查；未修改 manifest 或 HTML，未做手機安裝驗收。
validation.visual_review: 已目視檢查 192px 與 32px 縮圖；星核、斷環及中央留白可辨識。
